notes.s: Chasing a love he already knows he cannot keep, and refusing to stop.
notes.t: Title track of 화양연화 pt.2 from November 2015, the middle panel of the trilogy that made the group. Its video is the one fans still argue over, since it seeded the story of seven boys and a summer that goes wrong. In 2015 the word run read as the band's own position, still sprinting with nothing guaranteed, and the members name this one when asked which song defines the era.
k: 뛰다 is to run and, of a heart, to beat. That double sense carries the song: the plea asks to be made to run harder and to be made to feel more, and line 28 sets it beside 심장 so both senses fire at once. The pattern worth stealing is verb stem plus 게 하다, to make or let someone do something, with 주다 added to mean do it for my sake.

밖에 means outside of, and it refuses to sit in a sentence without a negative later on. So this is I can do nothing but this. Learners reach for 이것밖에 할 수 있어 and it is simply ungrammatical; the negative is compulsory, every time.

The -아 on the end is the vocative you hang on a name to call someone over, and sticking it on 운명 turns fate into a person standing there taking abuse. 나를 욕해 is a command rather than a statement, so: go on, curse me. Shouting at abstractions like this is a stock move in Korean lyric writing.

태우다 means burn, and it also means give someone a ride. Both read after a line about a branch drying out, though burn me is the primary sense. The clause after it, 더 밀쳐내줘, push me away harder, keeps the song's habit of requesting its own injuries.

vocab.note: The celestial body; 해 is the everyday word for the same thing
Literally the throat drying, and used for craving anything

vocab.en: the same spot, where you started
vocab.note: 제자리걸음 is marching in place, the standard image for getting nowhere
Noun built from 뛰다, slightly childlike, which is the point here
Used for physical and emotional damage alike
Bookish; 충분하다 is what you would actually say out loud
A remembered scene you look back on, where 기억 is the faculty of remembering
